items.title: Monster Beverage stock downgraded by Deutsche Bank as valuation limits upside
items.summary: Monster Beverage (NASDAQ:MNST) was downgraded to Hold from Buy by Deutsche Bank, with analysts arguing that the energy drink maker’s recent share price rally has left limited room for further gains despite the company’s continued operational strength. The brokerage also increased its price target to $98 but noted that the revised target represents only around 1% upside from current levels.
